episodes.title: Unpresidented
episodes.summary: As Reagan prepares to replace the president with a robot, she finds her hard-earned promotion threatened by a clueless but likable new colleague.

episodes.title: Clone Gunman
episodes.summary: When an expensive blunder forces budget cuts at Cognito Inc., J.R. orders Reagan and Brett to decide which of their co-workers should be fired.

episodes.title: Blue Bloods
episodes.summary: After a lizard people-related PR disaster, the team must do damage control at the swanky Reptoid Gala, where — to Reagan's dismay — hugs are required.

episodes.title: Sex Machina
episodes.summary: After Cognito Inc. buys a dating app, Reagan bets her team she can find a boyfriend — and creates a robot version of her perfect match to practice on.

episodes.title: The Brettfast Club
episodes.summary: Brett hopes to have a blast in the past as the team embarks on a nostalgia-laced mission to a small town that's permanently stuck in the '80s.

episodes.title: My Big Flat Earth Wedding
episodes.summary: Reagan conspires to keep her dad from finding out about her mom's wedding, while J.R. ropes Brett into a personal mission to help offload his mega-yacht.

episodes.title: Ghost Protocol
episodes.summary: Reagan sets an elaborate plan in motion to ghost a debonair British secret agent who grows too attached after a fling.

episodes.title: Buzzkill
episodes.summary: Desperate to get some space from her father, Reagan volunteers for a dangerous mission to the moon to make contact with a rogue colony.

episodes.title: Mole Hunt
episodes.summary: Exciting changes are afoot at Cognito Inc., but first, Reagan and her team must find the mole behind a security breach that could take down the company.

episodes.title: Inside Reagan
episodes.summary: To find a forgotten password and save Cognito Inc., Reagan goes deep into her mind and accesses memories from her dysfunctional childhood.

episodes.title: How Reagan Got Her Grove Back
episodes.summary: With Rand back in control of Cognito Inc., Reagan gets revenge - and has a hookup - at a Burning Man-style gathering of secret societies.

episodes.title: Whoas-Feratu
episodes.summary: Tamiko`s new beau is a Hollywood A-lister with a taste for blood, but that doesen`t stop a jealous Rand from trying to break up the cozy couple.

episodes.title: Reagan & Mychelle`s Hive School Reunion
episodes.summary: The Cognito crew plays along with Magic Myc`s big lies at a class reunion until he goes too far. Meanwhile, Rand finds a gross "gift" on his desk.

episodes.title: We Found Love in a Popeless Place
episodes.summary: Reagan has to turn the new, woke pope into a fire-and-brimstone pontiff, so she's off to Italy with a friend — and a little romance on the side.

episodes.title: Brettwork
episodes.summary: Brett`s an overnight sensation when he sits in as the host of a right-wing TV show, but quickly becomes a political puppet gleefully controlled by Rand.

episodes.title: Rontagion
episodes.summary: Now that she`s sleeping with the Illuminati, Reagan decides it`s time for the Cognito Inc. gang to meet Ron and persuade him to jump ship.

episodes.title: Project Reboot
episodes.summary: Rand unleashes Project Reboot as the Cognito co-workers learn about their alternate lives - and how a tin foil hat can actually come in handy.

episodes.title: Appleton
episodes.summary: With Cognito under new leadership, Reagan meets with the Robes who want a partnership, but she needs to make a big decision about her future.
